description: This PHP class is a subscriber that listens for module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard. Specifically, it handles changes related to the leave module, updating widget permissions when the leave module is deactivated or activated.

classes.name: LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: Subscriber class that listens for and handles module status change events, especially for the 'leave' module, to update relevant dashboard widget permissions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the module status change event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; if the previous module is 'leave', it updates the dashboard leave widget permissions based on the current module's status.
